stage: P2-57 replaceable printed cheeks and wheel-face shields
purpose: Prevent side-by-side wedging without changing the frozen P2-40 core or P2-51 ski and basket.

frozen_setup.geometry: P2-40 pivot, wheels, nip and rails; P2-51 R75/42-degree ski and basket

replaceable_front_parts.material_model: rigid printed part with smooth 0.05 friction contact surface

criteria.name: zero_side_by_side_jams
criteria.rule: no sustained two-ball throat lock in any of the six side-by-side runs per variant

criteria.name: series_regression_8_of_8
criteria.rule: both balls retained in all four sequential gaps at both tread friction values

criteria.name: rejected_ball_forward_push
criteria.rule: every non-captured ball remains free on the court and its maximum +X displacement from its initial world position is no more than 0.30 m

criteria.name: capture_half_width
criteria.rule: symmetric single-ball capture and retention succeeds through Y=+/-40 mm at both tread friction values

criteria.name: d5065_contact_current
criteria.rule: absolute modeled current no more than 20 A per motor

criteria.name: d5065_contact_torque
criteria.rule: absolute modeled torque no more than 0.62 N m per motor

criteria.name: forbidden_contact
criteria.rule: no ball or moving launcher contact with chassis, arch, camera or LiDAR

criteria.name: finite_state
criteria.rule: no NaN or Inf in observer or motor telemetry

limitations: deterministic Gazebo comparison, not a tolerance or wear study
printed-part compliance and surface finish are not represented
no STL or production release claim
